name: Agent Created
description: Fires when user successfully creates a new agent.

name: Agent Updated
description: Fires when user saves edits to an existing agent's name or description.

name: Agent Archived
description: Fires when user archives or unarchives an agent.

name: Agent Opened
description: Fires when user navigates to an individual agent detail page.

name: Knowledge Source Added
description: Fires when a document or text content is successfully saved to an agent.

name: Knowledge Source Deleted
description: Fires when user confirms deletion of a knowledge source.

name: Agent Training Started
description: Fires when user confirms starting a training run for an agent.

name: Subscription Plan Selected
description: Fires when user clicks to subscribe to a plan on the subscriptions page.

name: Subscription Cancelled
description: Fires when user confirms cancellation of their current subscription.

name: Channel Settings Saved
description: Fires when user saves web channel configuration for an agent.

name: WhatsApp Channel Connected
description: Fires when WhatsApp channel connection is successfully established.

name: Conversation Viewed
description: Fires when user opens a specific conversation thread.

name: Lead Captured
description: Fires when a new lead appears and user views the leads page.

name: Conversation Filter Applied
description: Fires when user filters conversations by agent or searches by keyword.
